chunks: God enjoins that you render to the owners what is held in trust with you, and that when you judge among the people do so equitably. Noble are the counsels of God, and God hears all and sees everything.

key_terms.الْأَمَانَاتِ: trusts or deposits held in confidence
key_terms.نِعِمَّا: excellent or noble is that which

ai.seo_question: What are the primary duties of believers regarding trusts and judgment according to this verse?
ai.summary: Known as the Verse of Trusts, this ayah is central to Shia jurisprudence, establishing the divine obligation of returning trusts to their rightful owners and administering justice, particularly in governance. It underscores the comprehensive nature of divine command by linking ethical conduct (amanat) with judicial integrity (adl), reflecting God's omniscience as the ultimate witness to human deeds.
